composition_notes: A short question in the upper register is answered below; the middle section narrows the gap.
The exact rhythm of question and answering echo is preserved; phrase-level register planning and a clear final cadence make the exchange more continuous.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
